result.summary: Cleans up p2p_node_network_limited.py by correcting inaccurate block height references in test log messages and replacing an ensure_for polling loop with an immediate assertion. The polling loop was unnecessary because block delivery lacks a trickle delay and can be reliably drained with a single ping.
result.problem: Comments and log messages in the test misstate relative block heights and off-by-one calculations, and an unnecessary ensure_for loop adds confusion when verifying block reception behavior.
evidence: Author description cites review feedback from #36446 (discussion_r4267602616).

Commit fa13e8954d notes that 'NODE_NETWORK_LIMITED_MIN_BLOCKS includes two blocks of buffer, so the "tip-288" and "tip-289" comments were wrong. Also, the first mined block is at height 1, not height 2.'
result.scope_notes: Small functional test cleanup touching only p2p_node_network_limited.py.
result.card: This pull request cleans up the functional test p2p_node_network_limited.py. It fixes inaccurate block height comments in test logs and replaces an ensure_for polling loop with a direct assertion after a ping. The change addresses review feedback from PR #36446 to simplify test logic where trickle delays do not apply. It has no dependencies and only affects test code.

risk.why: A mistake would only cause false test failures or test flakiness in the NODE_NETWORK_LIMITED test suite.
